name: monkey-maestro
description: Linear-first delivery supervision through native review and protected merge, with scoped Superset recovery.

interface.longDescription: Monkey Maestro supervises authorized Linear issue delivery through implementation, native review, and protected merge using one Superset workspace per issue. Live Linear state governs capacity and dependencies. Supervision lasts for the active session; scoped issue recovery and bounded quick fixes are also available.
defaultPrompt: Inspect this Linear project URL read-only and report its Maestro state.
Use Monkey Maestro to start project execution for this verified Linear project.
Use Monkey Maestro to supervise full issue delivery for this active authorized Linear project.
Use Monkey Maestro to inspect Superset transport for current In Progress issues without changing Linear.
Use Monkey Maestro to spawn one task-linked Superset workspace from live Linear state.
Use Monkey Maestro to deliver this exact issue through native review and protected merge in its Superset workspace.
Use Monkey Maestro to spawn this quick fix in a branch-bound Superset workspace without creating a Linear issue.
Use Monkey Maestro to stop future project dispatches without terminating active work.
